basic_details.job_title: ICAR-CMFRI Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: ICAR-CMFRI, Kochi, has invited applications for one contractual Project Assistant post under a Department of Biotechnology-funded project in the Fish Health section of its Marine Biotechnology, Fish Nutrition and Health Division. The pay is Rs. 30000/- per month (consolidated) for one year, extendable to one year. A Master's degree in the listed fisheries and life-science subjects with minimum 60% marks is essential. Bio-data, scanned documents and the filled-in Annexures I and II must reach [email protected] on or before 27 November 2026, and the interview is on 02/12/2026 (2 December 2026).

how_to_apply: Prepare the bio-data and the Annexure-I (application details) and Annexure-II (declaration about relatives) forms, both printed in the notice.
Sign the Annexure-I and Annexure-II declarations.
Scan the original supporting documents, including all certificates from 10th standard onwards.
Email the bio-data, the scanned documents and both annexures to [email protected] on or before 27 November 2026.
Wait for the e-mail on the interview date and time; only candidates who receive the communication may appear.
The notice does not give a subject line for the email.
important_instructions: Candidates must produce one valid ID proof at the time of interview. Candidates should produce the No Objection Certificate from their present employer, if any. Candidates with marks in CGPA/OGPA must produce the approved conversion table/formula at the time of reporting for interview, otherwise their candidature will not be considered. A candidate with a near or distant relative employed at ICAR-CMFRI must declare the name, designation, nature of duties and relationship in writing as in Annexure-II, and communicate it to the undersigned by post or email on or before 27 November 2026. If communicated or declared on the interview date, the candidate will not be interviewed. Condition 6 of the notice requires all candidates to submit the signed Annexure-I and Annexure-II declarations on or before 27 November 2026. The Annexure-II heading says candidates with no such relative will furnish it at the time of interview. Concealing of facts or canvassing in any form shall lead to disqualification or termination. The competent authority has the right to terminate without assigning any reason at any time. The decision of the Director, ICAR-CMFRI is final and binding in all respects.

content_sections.heading: About ICAR-CMFRI
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Director, ICAR-CMFRI, Kochi, the Central Marine Fisheries Research Institute under the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR). The post sits in a Department of Biotechnology-funded project on alginate oligosaccharides from seaweed as a feed additive for Silver pompano health management.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Desirable: work experience in fish nutrition and biochemistry / molecular biology /microbiology /biotechnology. Desirable: Swimming (printed under "Desirable" in the notice). Age limit: 21 to 45 years with relaxations as per the rule. Annexure-I asks for the applicant's age on 02 Dec, 2026. The notice does not list the relaxation amounts. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: Master's degree (M.F.Sc, M.V.Sc, MSc) in Fish Health/Nutrition/Fish physiology and Biochemistry/Aquaculture/Zoology/Biotechnology/Fisheries Science/Marine Biology/Marine Microbiology with minimum 60% marks

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The emoluments are Rs. 30000/- per month (Rs. Thirty thousand only per month), described as consolidated emoluments as per revised ICAR guidelines. The recruitment is purely on contractual basis for one year, extendable to one year. The notice states that the post is contractual, non-regular, time bound and co-terminus with the project, and selected candidates cannot claim any regular appointment at the institute.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICAR-CMFRI Project Assistant
content_sections.text: Prepare the bio-data and the Annexure-I (application details) and Annexure-II (declaration about relatives) forms, both printed in the notice. Sign the Annexure-I and Annexure-II declarations. Scan the original supporting documents, including all certificates from 10th standard onwards. Email the bio-data, the scanned documents and both annexures to [email protected] on or before 27 November 2026. Wait for the e-mail on the interview date and time; only candidates who receive the communication may appear. The notice does not give a subject line for the email.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice states that the date and time for the interview will be intimated to the shortlisted candidates by e-mail, and only those who receive communication may appear for the interview on the specified date and time. The date of interview is printed as 02/12/2026. Applicants who do not send the scanned certificates will not be allowed to appear for the interview. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing for the interview.
